sources.name: JPL Horizons
sources.used_for: Topocentric Sun and Earth altitude/azimuth samples from a lunar surface observer.
sources.notes: No API key required. The MVP requests OBSERVER tables with QUANTITIES='4' from CENTER='coord@301'. Results are sampled, not interpolated.

sources.name: LROC QuickMap / Lunaserv
sources.access: Public OGC WMS plus web viewer
sources.used_for: Visual map layers and topography context for lunar sites.
sources.notes: QuickMap moved to https://quickmap.lroc.im-ldi.com. The public WMS is https://wms.im-ldi.com/lroc/wms. Numeric DEM layers are not queryable for elevation via GetFeatureInfo, so the API does not claim point elevations from WMS.

sources.name: NASA Moon Trek
sources.access: OGC WMTS plus Trek catalog REST services
sources.used_for: WMTS basemap tiles and topography layer context.
sources.notes: Tiles follow https://trek.nasa.gov/tiles/Moon/{projection}/{layer}/1.0.0/... . The MVP ships a curated verified layer catalog instead of downloading the full live catalog on every request.

sources.name: CSA Moon Exploration
sources.notes: No public programmatic API was identified. It is intentionally not queried at runtime.

sources.name: NAIF SPICE
sources.notes: spiceypy and kernels are not installed in the MVP. The engine interface is ready for a future SPICE implementation.

sources.name: NASA PDS Geosciences Node
sources.used_for: Future local DEM ingestion and terrain-horizon modelling.
sources.notes: No runtime archive ingestion is implemented in the MVP.
